name: home-harmony
description: Monorepo root — run scripts from frontend or backend.

scripts.build:ci: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:production: npm run build:ci && npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm run verify:backend
scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.serve: npm run build:frontend && npm --prefix backend run start
scripts.serve:production: npm run build:production && npm --prefix backend run start
scripts.render:build: npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && node --check backend/server.js
